title: Successive Spring edits preserve bean identity and binding errors
summary: A single DataBinder accepts valid writes after an invalid nested count and keeps the field error across later edits.

change.description: A single DataBinder accepts valid writes after an invalid nested count and keeps the field error across later edits.

notes: Spring Framework 6.2.3. The 12 histories contain 36 observed prefixes. A fresh binder over the same bean clears its own error history. A caller that stops editing after an error is rejected.

The binder retained the rejected backup.count value after a successful primary.count write. Every prefix matched the independent model on Framework 6.2.3 and on the Security 6.3.0 / Framework 6.1.7 dependency graph.
